scenarios.name: test-copy-as-enters
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage InfiniteReflectionTest#testCopyAsEnters.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[etb-clone-defined-source-no-copy]: the failing path is Infinite Reflection's ETB replacement, not the TrigClone/Defined$ Remembered trigger: Reflections is DB$ Clone | Defined$ Enchanted | CloneTarget$ ReplacedCard, and replCtx marks it as an as-enters Clone election (CloneEnter.ETB) while recording no valid election (CloneEnter.ChoiceValid false, because the body's source is Defined$ Enchanted, not a Choices$ pick). effClone's ETB branch returns on !ChoiceValid without copying, so the Pillarfield Ox returned by Reanimate never becomes a copy of the enchanted Silvercoat Lion (transcript: Silvercoat Lion count 1, want 2). CR 614.1a, 707.2. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.
